validate: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run validate:repo --if-present
validate:fast: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && changed=$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all) && { if [ -z "$changed" ]; then echo 'validate:fast: no tests collected - the working tree is clean, so vitest run --changed selects nothing. Run npm run validate for the full suite, or vitest run --changed <ref> for the commits since <ref>.' >&2; exit 1; fi; vitest run --changed; }
